title: The Blue Hour of the fourth floor walk-up
author: Odile Delacroix
blurb: Zephyrine Villalobos, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
